content:
Hey all! I wanted to ask: is there a channel in this Zulip specifically purposed for blog post sharing?

I would like to subscribe to it and get notified about Lean-related blog posts as well as share them myself, but I was unable to find an appropriate channel. Do they get posted here in #general?

Also: is there any channel to discuss general (not Lean related) formal verification content?

Thanks!
You may be interested in #general > Lean in the wild
There is https://leanprover-community.github.io/blog/. But as far as I recall there is no Zulip thread that advertises these blog posts. Maybe there should be.
I think we've made posts in what is now #General announcements for community blog posts (I guess not consistently though), see e.g. #General announcements > Simprocs Blog Post .

Jovan Gerbscheid said:
